slices.name: Contract and No-Change Proof
slices.objective: Prove M5 frozen contracts unchanged before any executor proof: inventory surfaces, assert zero Core schema rewrite, freeze boundary
slices.acceptance_criteria: MULTI_EXECUTOR_CORE_SCHEMA_REWRITE_REQUIRED=no; ExecutionPackage executor-private field count=0; canonical roles unchanged; all 12 frozen contracts byte-identical to M5 KGC except explicitly authorized M6 hardening

slices.name: Second Executor Adapter Proof (Codex)
slices.objective: Implement Codex production-capable adapter under ExecutorAdapter; prove CHANGE_EXECUTOR != CHANGE_PLAN without Core schema rewrite
slices.acceptance_criteria: Codex implements all 7 adapter methods; typed unsupported where capability false; no Hermes-private or executor-private fields enter Core; no new canonical role

slices.name: Multi-Executor Dispatcher and Integration Proof
slices.objective: Prove dispatcher/registry handle reference+hermes+codex with deterministic 0/1/>1 resolution, capability negotiation, role mapping, artifact/WD, typed unsupported; add Core defense-in-depth for resume identity (F01)
output_contracts: F01 resume identity defense-in-depth at Core
slices.acceptance_criteria: 0 executors => EXECUTOR_NOT_FOUND fail closed; 1 => deterministic; >1 => NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE; resume with mismatched canonical_task_id fails at Core even with permissive adapter; idempotent cancel/resume verified across executors

slices.name: Surface-Reduction Implementation
slices.objective: Classify legacy surfaces and implement bounded reduction with measurement: retain/prove/reduce/retire/defer; each target has replacement, risk, typed retirement mechanism, negative acceptance; reduction only after replacement evidence
output_contracts: Before/after measurements (tool count, Skill complexity, duplicated logic, deployment coupling, choreography steps)
slices.acceptance_criteria: Every proposed reduction has named target, owner, consumers, why redundant, canonical replacement, compatibility risk, typed retirement (hard removal / typed unsupported / compatibility projection / deprecated-but-active), and negative acceptance; no Hermes-convenience-only removal

slices.name: CLI and Ingress Compatibility Convergence
slices.objective: Ensure Direct Core / Unified Ingress / CLI produce identical mechanical results for multi-executor dispatch; no new executor-specific CLI branch unless Issue authority requires; preserve parity
output_contracts: 3-way parity: Direct Core == Ingress == CLI for Codex dispatch
No executor-specific CLI leak unless authorized
slices.acceptance_criteria: Same package via Direct Core, Ingress, and CLI yields identical dispatch/result/error with identical audit; executor param remains explicit; no heuristic selection added

slices.name: Source Guard and Regression Convergence
slices.objective: Evolve source guard without wildcard allowlist; converge full regression including M4 129 + M5 370 + new M6 corpus; per-work-item provenance
output_contracts: Full regression PASS (M4 129 + M5 370 + M6 new, zero failures)
slices.acceptance_criteria: M4 regression 129/129, M5 regression 370/370, full 499 baseline retained plus new M6 corpus green; source guard rejects wildcard production allowlist and tests/test_m6_*.py blanket bypass

slices.name: Milestone Review, Reconciliation, and Known-Good Checkpoint
slices.objective: Independent review of M6 multi-executor proof and surface reduction; verify source immutability, closure guard, and KGC advancement
slices.acceptance_criteria: PASS verdict on independent review, 0 blocking findings, full suite passing
